page_title: UNI 2-2 HEI | Union Berlin v Heidenheim 24/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' Deniz Aytekin blows for a foul after Patrick Mainka (Heidenheim) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Union Berlin have been awarded a free kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Nenad Bjelica decides to make a substitution. Lucas Tousart will be replaced by Alex Kral (Union Berlin).
87' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
85' Shots on target – 3:4.
83' A substitution has been made. Lennard Maloney is replaced by Tim Siersleben (Heidenheim).
83' Lennard Maloney (Heidenheim) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
81' That's the end of the game for Brenden Aaronson, who is replaced by Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin).
81' Nenad Bjelica has decided to substitute Robin Gosens and he is replaced by Jerome Roussillon (Union Berlin).
77' The attendance is 22012.
76' Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
73' Substitution. Jonas Fohrenbach is replaced by Norman Theuerkauf (Heidenheim).
72' The game has come to an end for Jan-Niklas Beste. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Kevin Sessa (Heidenheim).
72' Substitution. Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen (Union Berlin) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Benedict Hollerbach walks off.
72' Nenad Bjelica prepares a substitution. Josip Juranovic is replaced by Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin).
71' 2 - 2 Goal! Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) picks up a pass and gets to the edge of the box before clipping a brilliant lob over the goalkeeper and into the empty net. He makes it 2:2.
70' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

70' Brenden Aaronson (Union Berlin) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball goes out of play. Union Berlin are awarded a corner kick.
64' Frank Schmidt has decided to make a change. Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) replaces Nikola Dovedan.
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jan Schoppner leaves the pitch and Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) comes on.

63' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) rises above the defence to meet the corner. His timing is good, but he arrows his header just a few inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
63' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) takes the corner.
62' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
61' Some great controlled play and passing from Union Berlin. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
58' A lofted cross from Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
55' The Heidenheim players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
53' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.

53' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) unleashes a cannonball of a shot from the edge of the area, but it zips narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
52' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) but poses no threat.
51' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 3:3.
49' The Union Berlin players are exchanging some short passes.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' 2 - 1 Goal! Robin Gosens unleashes a strike and Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) deflects the shot into the net with his body. 2:1.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
44' 1 - 1 Goal! Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 1:1.
43' Deniz Aytekin interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Andras Schafer (Union Berlin). Heidenheim win a free kick.
43' Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Deniz Aytekin blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Union Berlin in a dangerous position.
42' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Frederik Ronnow, who smothers the ball.
39' Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) places a shot at goal from the edge of the box that bends just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.

34' The corner is swung in and Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) leaps above the defence only to send his header a whisker wide of the right post from close in. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
33' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
32' Union Berlin control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
25' There's an opportunity for Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

24' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) controls a cross inside the box and sends a low drive towards the right post, but one of the defenders reacts superbly to block his effort. Heidenheim will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
23' Great teamplay by Union Berlin as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
22' Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle. Kevin Vogt (Union Berlin) commits a foul after dangerous play.
19' Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
18' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Frederik Ronnow intercepts the ball.
16' Ball possession – 61:39.
13' Union Berlin seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
11' Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
5' The corner by Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.

3' 0 - 1 Goal! That was a fantastic finish by Nikola Dovedan (Heidenheim) from just outside the box. He wasted little time in getting away a bullet of a shot that flew past the goalkeeper into the right side of the net.
1' The first half has started.
Deniz Aytekin got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
